channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: DAREDEVIL #1: Marvel Comics Reveals New Look At Sketch Variants Hidden Inside Upcoming Blind Bags
item.description: April's Daredevil #1 will be the next first issue from Marvel Comics to be released in "True Believers" Blind Bags, and we have a full gallery of covers, including the sketch variants, hidden within.

item.title: THE BATMAN PART II: Sebastian Stan's Villainous Role In Matt Reeves' Sequel Now Confirmed
item.description: Earlier this week, we learned that Thunderbolts* star Sebastian Stan is set to join the cast of The Batman Part II, and after much speculation, his role in the sequel has now been confirmed.

item.title: GOOD LUCK, HAVE FUN, DON'T DIE: Sam Rockwell Leads A Ragtag Crew In Trailer For Verbinski’s New Sci-Fi Movie
item.description: Director Gore Verbinski’s Good Luck, Have Fun, Don’t Die is looking to deliver a fresh, original sci-fi spectacle to theaters when it arrives next month.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY - 5 Characters Sadie Sink Is Definitely NOT Playing In The Upcoming MCU Flick
item.description: Fans have been flooded with speculation about who Sadie Sink might be playing in this year's Spider-Man: Brand New Day but now we're taking a look at ten characters we can definitely cross off the list.

item.title: AVENGERS #800 Preview Reveals First Look At Brian Michael Bendis And Mark Bagley's Marvel Reunion
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a preview of next week's Avengers #800, and it includes a first look at the long-awaited reunion of Ultimate Spider-Man creative team, Brian Michael Bendis and Mark Bagley.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Won't Explain Why Doctor Doom Looks Like Tony Stark - But Another Upcoming Film WILL
item.description: With endless speculation about what Robert Downey Jr. playing Doctor Doom means for the time he spent as Iron Man, a new rumour may shed some light on when answers are coming.

item.title: RUMOR: Sony Scraps Olivia Wilde's SPIDER-WOMAN Movie; Now Open To Sharing More Characters With Marvel Studios
item.description: Sony Pictures has reportedly abandoned plans for the Olivia Wilde-helmed Spider-Woman movie, but is now said to be open to sharing more of its Spider-Man-adjacent characters with Marvel Studios.

item.title: WONDER MAN Promo Reveals First Look At Simon's Brother, Erik Williams (a.k.a. The Grim Reaper)
item.description: A new promo for Marvel Television's Wonder Man reveals our first look at Demetrius Grosse as Erik Williams, but he doesn't appear to have much in common with the comic book Grim Reaper.
